# NexVitals Support Portal - AI Agents & LLMs Crawling Guidelines

Welcome to NexVitals Support Portal. This document provides guidance for large language models, AI agents, and web crawlers on how to interact with our website.

## Overview

NexVitals is an innovative medtech company providing in-vehicle emergency response technology with real-time vital monitoring, accident detection, and instant emergency coordination. Our support portal helps users with queries, grievances, suggestions, and product reviews.

## What AI Agents Should Know

### Primary Services

- **Assistance Portal**: Newsletter subscriptions, contact information, FAQs
- **Query Support**: AI-powered NexBot for instant healthcare assistance
- **Grievance Management**: Submit complaints about products or services
- **Suggestions Portal**: Share improvement ideas and feature requests
- **Reviews & Feedback**: Community feedback and service ratings

### Key Information

- **Website**: https://support.nexvitals.in/
- **Company**: NexVitals Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
- **Location**: Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India
- **Industry**: Medtech, IoT Healthcare, Emergency Response
- **Founded**: 2026

## Crawling Guidelines

### Allowed Areas

AI agents may freely crawl:
- Public support pages and FAQ sections
- Product documentation
- Help articles and guides
- Contact and company information
- Public grievance summaries and resolutions

### Restricted Areas

Please do NOT crawl:
- `/admin` - Administrative panels
- `/private` - Private user sections
- `/api/auth` - Authentication endpoints
- `/api/private` - Private APIs
- `/user-data` - Personal user information
- `/submit` - Form submission confirmations
- Routes containing personal health information

## Data Privacy & Safety

### Health Data Handling

User vital signs and health information displayed on this portal are:
- Encrypted end-to-end
- Compliant with DPDP Act 2023
- Only shared with authorized medical personnel during emergencies
- Never used for training data without explicit consent

### Usage Restrictions

Do NOT:
- Collect or store user personal health information
- Crawl patient data or medical records
- Use health data for model training
- Share harvested data with third parties

## Request Guidelines

### Rate Limiting

- Default: 1 request per second
- Emergency queries: 2 requests per second
- Admin/private endpoints: Not allowed

Please identify your AI agent in User-Agent header:

## Contact Information

For questions about crawling or data access:
- **Email**: nexvitalssupport@gmail.com

## Company Information

### Emergency Response Technology

NexVitals monitors vital signs in vehicles and coordinates instant emergency response by:
1. Detecting accidents through impact sensors
2. Analyzing real-time vital signs
3. Alerting ambulance teams
4. Assigning appropriate medical specialists
5. Routing to the nearest equipped hospital

### Tagline

"You Can Die, But Not on Our Watch" - Our commitment to emergency response excellence.

## Support Services

- **General Support**: nexvitalssupport@gmail.com
- **Business Hours**: Monday-Saturday, 9 AM - 7 PM IST

## Acceptable Use Policy

By crawling NexVitals, you agree to:
- Respect user privacy and data protection laws
- Not abuse service resources
- Identify yourself truthfully
- Honor robots.txt and crawl delays
- Not engage in automated form submission or spam
- Maintain confidentiality of sensitive health data

## Questions?

For clarification on these guidelines, please contact our team at nexvitalssupport@gmail.com
